card.name: Linking words before enzyme or clock terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, an, of, are, key) and word pieces just before an enzyme, transporter or circadian-clock term. Seen in drug-interaction text such as 'is a CYP2C8 substrate' and in the PER2 clock passage.

modes.label: Linking word before enzyme role
modes.description: A small word like a, an, of or are comes right before a named enzyme, transporter or substrate role.

modes.label: Circadian clock passage
modes.description: Words inside the PER2 sentence about the mammalian circadian clock.
modes.example: is a key component of the mamm<<alian>> circadian clock machinery.

modes.label: Inside bexarotene
modes.description: Part of the drug name bexarotene, or the verb right after it.
modes.example: Bex<<ar>>otene capsules should be continued as long

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks small connecting words in sentences that are about to name an enzyme, a drug transporter or the body clock.
